canonical_answers: n=PV/RT; attractions or particle volume cause nonideal behavior.

payload.text: A gas sample at 298 K occupies 1.80 L at 0.950 atm.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate moles using PV=nRT and explain a likely high-pressure deviation.

criteria.description: n=PV/RT; attractions or particle volume cause nonideal behavior.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show PV=nRT; intermolecular.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Explain how the ideal gas law's assumptions of negligible intermolecular attraction and negligible molecular volume justify using PV=nRT here, and state the assumption that the gas behaves ideally at 298 K and 0.950 atm.

criteria.description: PV=nRT relies on negligible intermolecular attraction and molecular volume, assuming the gas behaves ideally at these conditions.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show negligible intermolecular forces; ideal behavior assumption.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Describe how you would test for nonideal behavior, identifying the compressibility factor PV/nRT as the measured variable while holding temperature constant.

criteria.description: A valid check measures the compressibility factor PV/nRT across pressures while holding temperature constant.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show compressibility factor; temperature held constant.

parts.label: (d)
parts.prompt: State one boundary case (e.g., high pressure where attractive forces dominate) and predict whether the moles calculated from the ideal gas law would be too high or too low compared to the true value.

criteria.description: At high pressure, attractive forces lower the measured pressure below the ideal prediction, making the calculated moles too high.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show high pressure deviation; moles too high.

accessibility.accommodation_notes: Text and symbolic notation are fully described.
